tools.name: search_encyclopedia
tools.description: Find metals, minerals, ingredients and materials, potions, gems, the milieux, animals, plants and creatures of Biomes and the reference pages of Hearth, Passage and Bearer by name (case- and accent-insensitive; exact names first, then prefixes, then substrings, aliases included). Returns each hit with its kind, id, one-line summary and page url; call get_entry for the full data.

q.description: The name or part of it.

lang.description: Language of the texts: en (default), fr, or all for both.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: The full data of one entry (a metal, mineral, ingredient, potion, gem, milieu, animal, plant, creature or reference page) by its id (from search_encyclopedia or list_entries): properties, lore, page url, embed_url.

kind.description: Which catalogue: metal, mineral, ingredient, potion, gem, milieu, animal, plant, monster, hearth_page, passage_page, bearer_page.

lang.description: Language of the texts: en (default), fr, or all for both.

tools.name: list_entries
tools.description: A page of one catalogue, filtered. Use it to answer "which minerals are cubic and gem-quality?", "legendary metals of the medieval era", "swamp ingredients with a fire essence". Combine with q for a name search inside the filter.

kind.description: Which catalogue: metal, mineral, ingredient, potion, gem, milieu, animal, plant, monster, hearth_page, passage_page, bearer_page.

filters.description: Field filters as {name: "value" | "value1,value2"} (any-of, case-insensitive). Names per catalogue: metal → category, era, rarity, fictional, tag; mineral → type, system, rarity, gem_quality, color, magic, planar_origin, origin; ingredient → category, rarity, realm, biome, landform, structure, qualifier, essence, creature_type, part; potion → essence; gem → color, rarity, temporary; milieu → realm, group; animal → kind, size, danger, activity, domestic and the place filters; plant → kind and the place filters; monster → type, size, cr, danger and the place filters; hearth_page, passage_page, bearer_page → none (search by name with q). list_facets gives the values.

lang.description: Language of the texts: en (default), fr, or all for both.

tools.name: random_entry
tools.description: One entry at random among those matching the filters: loot tables, "mineral of the day", a credible metal for a blacksmith, a foraging roll.

tools.description: Every distinct value of each filterable field of a catalogue (categories, rarities, crystal systems, biomes, essences…) and its entry count.

tools.name: craft_rules

lang.description: Language of the texts: en (default), fr, or all for both.

tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Published tracks of MGS Audio (music, ambiences, sound effects) with composer, album, moods, keywords, duration and page url. Metadata only: no audio file. "A battle theme" → genre: "Combat", type: "music"; "a forest ambience" → type: "ambience", genre: "Forest"; "something for a dungeon" → keyword: "dungeon".

type.description: Audio type(s), comma-separated: music, ambience, sfx…

genre.description: Theme(s), comma-separated, case-insensitive: Combat, Forest, Dungeon, Taverns and Inns, Magic, Weather… (audio_taxonomy lists them).

mood.description: Musical style(s), comma-separated: Orchestral, Celtic, Folk, Medieval, Metal…

q.description: Text search in title, description, keywords.
